newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australian May manufacturing input prices rise.
newsitem.headline: Australian May manufacturing input prices rise.

text.p: Australian manufacturing input prices increased 0.5 percent in May from the previous month and were 2.9 percent lower than a year earlier, the Australian Bureau of Statistics said on Tuesday.
"The rise in the index this month was mainly due to higher prices for a number of agricultural materials and metal ores," the bureau said.
These rises were partly offset by further falls in imported crude oil prices.
